newsitem.title: SPAIN: Truck runs over and kills striking Spanish driver.
newsitem.headline: Truck runs over and kills striking Spanish driver.

text.p: A striking truck driver was run over and killed in northern Spain early on Thursday as he tried to halt a passing truck, local media reported.

The French truck was travelling at high speed and instantly killed the man, who had walked onto the highway attempting to stop the truck, local media reported. The driver fled, but police later took a man into custody some 40 kilometres from the scene, media reported.
A week-long strike has spread to almost all of northern Spain with a large part of the country's 300,000 truck drivers out.
Strikers are pushing for a restructuring of their sector including retirement at 60 years, instead of the current 65, and renegotiation of gasoline costs.

Last year, French truck drivers paralysed roads and disrupted much of Western Europe with a 12-day blockade forcing the French government to concede to a number of demands including retirement at 55 instead of 60.
